workarounds.symptom: [BUG] crewai deploy list crashes or claims "no Crews" when the API returns an error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): report deploy list API errors instead of "no Crews". Target files: lib/cli/src/crewai_cli/deploy/main.py, lib/cli/tests/deploy/test_deploy_main.py. `DeployCommand.list_crews` parsed the response body before checking the status code, so a failing Enterprise API either crashed the command with a `JSONDecodeError` (non-JSON error body) or was reported as `You don't have any Crews yet` (JSON error body with a non-200 status). A 401 was also shown as "no Crews" instead of asking the user to log in again. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9756)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] crewai+ commands exit 0 when the Enterprise API returns an error response
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): exit 1 when the Enterprise API returns an error response. Target files: lib/cli/src/crewai_cli/command.py, lib/cli/tests/deploy/test_deploy_main.py. `PlusAPIMixin._validate_response` reported every failed `crewai+` API call with a bare `raise SystemExit`. `SystemExit()` carries `code None`, which Python reports as exit status 0, so a non-JSON body, a 422, or any other non-2xx response printed an error and still exited successfully. The 401 path already exits 1 through `AuthenticationRequiredError`, so these siblin... (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/9754)
